name: Polymyalgia Rheumatica
definition: Inflammatory syndrome in adults over 50 characterized by bilateral shoulder and often hip-girdle pain and prolonged morning stiffness, usually with elevated inflammatory markers.

redFlags.item: New headache, scalp tenderness, jaw claudication or visual symptoms suggesting giant cell arteritis
Fever/weight loss raising concern for infection or malignancy

investigations.principle: ESR/CRP and clinical response support diagnosis after excluding mimics.
investigations.MRI: Ultrasound may show bursitis/tenosynovitis; MRI rarely required.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs mainly assess alternative joint disease.

green: Careful glucocorticoid treatment and monitoring when diagnosed
amber: Any GCA symptom requires same-day urgent pathway due to risk of irreversible visual loss.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata/Ama stiffness phenotype may be documented only in parallel with modern inflammatory evaluation.

patientEducation.summary: Inflammatory syndrome in adults over 50 characterized by bilateral shoulder and often hip-girdle pain and prolonged morning stiffness, usually with elevated inflammatory markers.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for severe/progressive neurological deficit, vascular compromise, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.

sources.title: Recommendations for management of polymyalgia rheumatica
